tei:div.tei:p: (589)༄// yang zab dgon mchog spyi 'dus kyi tshe dbang gi mtshams sbyor bklag chog ma bzhugs// (590)

oṃ swa sti/ 'gyur bcas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pas gzhom med kyang*// ye shes rdo rje'i mthar byas mi shig sapa'i// tshe yi mchog stsol padma 'od 'bar la/ btud de dbang gi mtshams sbyor ngag 'don spel// 'dir dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i tsho dbang bskur ba la/ yo byad bshams bkod dang*/ sgrub mchod rnams 'grub par byas la/ slob ma rnams phyag byas gral la 'khod pa dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣi ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes dang yig brgya bzla bzhin du las bum gyis khrus bya/ bgegs gtor/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa byangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrum̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya ba'i nang du 'bru gsum zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs/ oṃ sarba bhuta a karṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ sarba bignaṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu sogs nas/ ba liṃ ta swa hā/ zhes slob ma rnams la bskor/ lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ na mo rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ rig 'dzin bla ma padma 'od 'bar tshe dpag tu med pa'i dkyil (591)'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam par dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyi deng 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la byin rlabs tshe'i dbang bskur zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la dpag tshad dang rgyang grags su ma gnas par gzhan su dengs shig gal te mi 'gro na khro bo ye shes kyi rdo rje'i me rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyod rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes sum bhā ni

sogs drag sngags spos rol dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me dpung mkha' khyab tu 'phros pas bcing ste cis kyang mi shigs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces mtshams bcad/ me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de ma thob kyi bar du phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing bsam pa'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ khyad par du tshe'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi nas 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub myur du thob pa'i ched du dkon mchog gsum spyi 'dus bla ma padma (592)'od 'bar tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur zab mo zhu snyam pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa yang*/ rtog pa thams cad legs par= brlab/ zhes dang*/ rab tu dma' ba'i= bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar snod kyi skyon rnams spangs la/ sgo gsum sdom la zhi dul dad gus spyod lam rnam par dag pas legs par nyan 'tshal/ de yang don du gnyer bya yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang de nyid kyi rten phun sum tshogs pa ni/ zhi ba lhas/ mi yi gru la= log ces gsungs pa ltar/ da lta dal 'byor bco brgyad tshang ba'i mi lus rin po che 'di rnyed par dka' ba yin pas/ de ni u dumba ra'i me tog ltar shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ltar rnyed na don chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ slob spring las/ bde gshegs lam ston 'gro ba 'dren par chas/ sems can kyi stobs = lam de lha dang= mkha' lding rig 'dzin= mi yi dngos po= don du brtag pa= ces gsungs pa bzhin/ de ltar thob pas mi chog spyir 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshe la nges pa med cing*/

khyad par snyigs ma lnga bdo'i tshe'i snyigs ma mthar thug pas dus min du 'chi ba'i rkyen dang bar chad mang po dang (593)ldan pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang= zhes spyir chos sgrub pa la bar chad kyi rkyen mang zhing*/ khyad par du dus min 'chi ba'i rkyen mang bas tshe dang las dang bsod nams zad pa ste rkyang zad gsum/ de dag las gnyis gnyis zad pa ste gsum las/ tshe zad pa la tshe sgrub kyi sgo dang*/ las zad pa la srog blu nye'u 'don pa la sogs dang*/ bsod nams zad pa la mchod sbyin spel ba sogs pa'i gnyen pos/ de dag re re'am gnyis gnyis zad pa rnams gso nus par gsungs pa las/ tshe nyid nyams pa'i rkyen/ nyams pa'i rtags/ gso byed slob dpon/ gso ba'i tshul dang bzhir bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'chi med tshe'i rgyud las gsungs pa ste/ de las nyams pa'i rkyen ni/ rgyud de las/ dam nyams= zhe sdang= sku gsung thugs = gnas= tshe nyams = zhes gsungs/ nyams pa'i rtags ni/ de las/ 'khor= bzhin= slob dpon= kha= 'di dag= gso byed kyi slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ de las/ ting 'dzin= rgyud= mthu= 'di zhes gsungs/ ji ltar gso tshul gyi cho ga la 'jug par byed pa ni/ klu sgrub kyis/ 'chi ba'i rkyen ni mang ba ste/ gson pa'i rkyen ni nyung zad cig ces gsungs (594)pas/ dus min gyi 'chi rkyen shin tu mang la de las thar bar 'dod pa dag gis lhag pa'i lha khyad par can brten par bya dgos te/ zhi ba lhas/ dpal la brten nas= brten/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa mi bzad pa las skyob pa'i ched du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje nus pa gcig tu bsdus pa ni/ bdag nyid rig 'dzin bla ma padma 'od 'bar mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa 'di nyid yin la/ de nyid sgrub pa'i thabs kyi bka' srol gyi cho ga 'di ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad kyi spyi gzugs o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis sngon dus las can gyi rje 'bangs rnams dang*/

ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams la dgongs te zab lam gyi gdams pa khyad par can du ma gsungs shing*/ sgrub gnas gangs brag la sogs pa'i gter gnas rnams su mi 'jig pa'i rgya dang bcas te gter du sbas par mdzad pa la/ 'dir padma'i zhal lung 'od 'phro las/ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po yi// skye mtha'i sangs rgyas de yin pas// ming yang 'ja' tshon snying po'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i yang srid sprul pa'i rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po (595)ste/ thang yig las/ lho kong byang kong sbas pa'i gter kha 'di/ mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags de= o rgyan las 'phro gling pa= zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ mtshan las 'phro gling pa'am sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag me 'bar zhes grags pa de nyid kyis kong yul wa ru ṇa rdod hom 'phrang lcags kyi sgo mo nas spyan drangs bar mdzad pa'i zab mo'i gter chos dkon mchog spyi 'dus zhes byin rlabs kyi tshan kha gzhan las khyad par du gyur pa'i chos sde 'di'i tshe'i dbang bskur gyi rim pa sgrub par byed pa/ yid ches bskyed byed brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa gnyis/ dang po bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku thugs rje chen po/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po/ sprul pa'i gter ston rig 'dzin 'dza'atshon snying po/ kong smyon he ru ka dpal kun bzang rnam rgyal/ 'khrul zhig khams gsum rang grol/ gsang bdag phrin las lhun grub/ gter chen chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa sogs las brgyud de rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar/ de nyid kyis thugs dgyes pa chen pos bstsal ba'i gdams pa de la'ang*/ bdag don du tshe sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ gzhan (596)don du tshe yi dbang bskur ba'i rim pa gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir byin rlabs tshe'i dbang bskur ba'i rim pa sgrub par byed pa'i skabs su bab pa yin zhing*/

de la'ang rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba dang slob ma'i bya ba gnyis su yod pa las/ slob dpon gyi bgyi'os rnams lhag chad med par sngon du song grub/ da slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa ni bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la byin rlabs tshe yi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu zhes brda sbyar la slob mas maṇḍal 'dul/ de nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma padma 'od 'bar mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mchog gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba mngon sum gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal chen po las 'jigs te skyabs su zhu na ci mdzad khyed mkhyen gyi re ltos ling bsgyur gyi skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral te rnam grol gtan gyi bde ba la 'god pa'i ched du bla na med pa'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pa'i ngang nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: skyabs gnas dam pa= sogs (597)lan gsum/ de nas byin rlabs kyi gzhi sgrub par byed pa ye shes pa dbab pa yin pas/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus gnad skyil krung drang por bsrang*/ ngag gnad rlung kha sbyor 'ching*/ sems gnad dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog rnam smin sha khrag gdos bcas kyis mtshon pa'i ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad mi dmigs par gyur/ bsang chu 'thor/ oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi gnas khang ma yin par dpal ri padma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen po dwangs gsal sgrib med gsal ba'i dbus su pad nyi zla ba'i gdan la rang rig chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du dkon mchog gsum spyi 'dus bla ma padma 'od 'bar gyi sku snang stong sgyu mar lta bur gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/

mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las mu med pa'i 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros pas padma 'od sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams tshad med pa nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad rig 'dzin bla ma padma 'od 'bar 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs kyi rnam par kha ba dang bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas (598)so so rang gi spyi bo nas sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa sogs dang*/ thod phreng rtsal dang*/ a wāe sha ya a āḥ zhes spol rol dang bcas pas byin dbab phebs nas/ de ltar byin phab pa'i ye shes pa khyed rang rnams la ro gcig tu brtan par byas byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces rdo rje rgya gram gyis rgyas gdab la/ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod/ de nas dbang zhu ba'i slad du slob dpon nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo tshe dpag tu med pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa la mi phyed pa'i gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi= sogs lan gsum/ zhes mos gus kyis gsol ba btab pas nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi/ rkyen ngan nyi khri chig stong*/ ye 'grog sum brgya drug cu/ bgegs rigs stong prag brgyad cu/ tshe yi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rigs ngan pa thams cad byang bar gyur cig de nas tshe 'gugs shing dbang bskur ba'i slad du khyod rang rig 'dzin padma 'od 'bar du gsal ba'i gnas lngar phyag mtshan lnga dpa' bo 'bru lngas mtshan pa rnams las 'od zer mkha' khyab tu 'phros pas phyogs bzhi steng 'og skyong ba'i tshe bcud bkrag dang gzi mdangs phyi snod 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma/ nang (599)bcud skye 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i tshe dpal nus stobs/ gsang bcud rgyal ba sras bcas kyi thugs rje byin rlabs kyi nus mthu thams cad dkar 'tsher snu rngam la 'dril ba'i rnam par bsdus te spyi bo nas thim pas 'chi med tshe yi dpal la dbang 'byor ba'i mos pa mdzod/

tshe'i mda' dar g.yab cing*/ hriḥ phyi ni bum pa= dbang thob shog rtsa sngags/ rol mo 'khrol/ de nas nam mkha' gang ba'i lha rnams kyi 'chi med bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ de las 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par 'phros pa spyi bo nas zhugs/ rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho/ 'gyur ba med pa'i tshe/ 'chi ba med pa'i srog mi shigs pa rdo rje tshe'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod cig bum pa'i dbang spyi bor ma bskur/ hrī bum pa'i ngo bo sogs/ sngags/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bum chu blud cing*/ tshe dbang brgya rtsa 'di man chad nas byed dgos/ hrīḥbum pa'i bdud rtsi= sngags/ a bhi/ lag g.yas su thabs kyi rdzas ril bu byin pas thabs bde ba chen po mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rje tshe yi dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hriḥ sngon byon dus gsum= sngags/ a bhi/ zhes g.yas su tshe ril gtad la brar bcug go (600) lag g.yon du shes rab kyi rdzas btung ba byin pas stong pa nyid mi shigs rdo rje'i tshe'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ sngon byon drang srong= sngags a bhi= zhes tshe chang lag g.yon du gtad la 'thung bcag 'dir gtor dbang rtsa ba'i dbang gzhung las mi 'byung yang sngags tsam gyis bskur ba'i phyag srol ltar spros pa la dga' na tshe gtor btegs la/ gtor ma 'di nyid rig 'dzin bla ma padma 'od 'bar rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams kyis bskor ba tshe yi dkyil 'khor gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa rnams dgyes pa chen pos ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyi bo nas thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad mer khrig gis gang bas 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i srog thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥ mdangs ldan lhun grub 'od zer thig le'i dbus// rnam kun rgyal ba sras bcas rig 'dzin tshogs// dkon mchog spyi 'dus padma 'od 'bar rtsal// sgyu 'phrul tshe lha'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dbang*// deng 'dir bskur

ro rdo rje gsum 'grub shog rtsa sngags / kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wakā siddhi āḥ sitta siddhi hūm̐/ sarba siddhi hrīḥ zhes tshe gtor gyis dbang bskur ro/ de nas tshe brtan par bya ba'i phyir rgyas gdab pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi cha thams cad rdo rje'i go khrab kyis zhu lugs su 'od 'khyil li li khyab ste (601)cis kyang mi shigs par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ me tog 'thor bzhin du tshe mdas rgyas gdab ste/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐/ hrīḥ dang po chos kyi= sogs/ zhes tshigs bcas kyis bkra shis rnams kyi me tog gis char dbab par bya/ de ltar tshe'i dbang thob nas spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig rnams srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ de ltar tshe yi dbang bskur zab mo thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi don du maṇḍal phul bar mdzod/

ces slob ma maṇḍal 'bul gzhug slar yang lus longs spyo dge tshogs rgya mtsho dang bcas pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal srid kyi 'byor pa chen po ltar sprul zhing phul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas sogs/ de lta bu'i dge ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bsngo bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs/ (602)
